A separate 2013 three-weight-dual paper at exponent 182 implies the same baseline A4=24200 and potentially covers the baseline through an unidentified equivalence, but it does not cover the distinct 16 and 20 coefficients. The 2013 three-weight paper arXiv:1308.5373 gives a related dual weight distribution at exponent 182; at m=5 its MacWilliams-implied A4 equals the baseline value 24200. An independent equivalence to C_2 may make the baseline previously implied, but the comparison with exponents 16 and 20 is not covered by that formula.
The values are established only for m=5, not for the full odd-m families.
